column1: # Rules accepted on purpose after reading the first staging report (2026-10-22). Format: rule id, action, reason.

column3: CSP script-src and style-src 'unsafe-inline': Next.js writes inline scripts and styles into every page; removing it needs per-request nonces (dynamic rendering of every page). Everything else in the policy is tight (see next.config.ts). Revisit after launch.

Sub Resource Integrity: the pages load the pinned Aladin Lite script from CDS on request; an integrity hash would break on any change at CDS and the version is already pinned. Same-origin scripts are not affected.
Cross-Origin-Embedder-Policy: setting it would block the sky tiles (CDS) and map tiles (OpenStreetMap) the pages embed.
Cross-Origin-Opener-Policy / Sec-Fetch headers: low value for a site with no pop-up sign-in; revisit with COOP same-origin after the real-phone pass.
Timestamp disclosure (Unix): numbers in the page that look like times (build data); not secret.
Non-storable content: pages are rendered per request on purpose (live data).
Cache-control directives on /classroom and /scan: per-request pages, no sensitive data cached shared.
